parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC peering connection.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the VPC peering connection.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

- Do not specify this parameter for the first request.

- You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPC peering connection.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see [What is a resource group?](~~94475~~).

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of a VPC in the peering connection. You can specify the ID of the requester or accepter VPC. If you specify only one VPC ID, the query returns all peering connections that involve the specified VPC.
